settings.heading: A trauma-informed practice grounded in relationship
settings.body: Center for Balanced Living is a clinician-owned psychology practice serving the MOT area of Delaware. We provide therapy, psychological evaluation, groups, workshops, and consultation, integrating evidence-based practice with warmth, attunement, and clinical depth.

settings.title: Trauma-Informed
settings.text: Calm, regulated, and grounded in nervous-system-aware practice.

settings.title: Diagnostically Precise
settings.text: Thorough evaluation that brings clarity and direction.

settings.title: Relational & Warm
settings.text: Care that honors the whole person, not just the symptom.

settings.heading: Let's talk about how we can help
settings.body: Reach out for a consultation or to ask a question. We respond within 24–48 hours.
